description: Geometry-only audit of original radar_simulator random coastline and object generators using one frozen synthetic in-memory coastline primitive. No capture-derived library, model artifact, or rendering.

generator.library_scope: one fixed synthetic primitive reused across every seed and condition; no claim about the capture-derived library's shape distribution
generator.synthetic_library_primitive: 32-vertex closed radial ellipse in local XY, passed through legacy.build_primitive_from_coastline for native classification and normalization; source_pattern=synthetic_audit_fixture; echo_stats={}

range_interpretation: max_range_m passed to the original geometry generators; coastline excursion counts use it as a nominal reporting boundary, while object centers are additionally checked against the generator's 0.95 max-range placement bound

bounds.meaning: nominal report thresholds; outlying generated geometry is counted, never rejected by the audit
